title: Radiating
description: A short word in heavy Geist on warm white, its outline echoed outward in evenly spaced black lines until the whole box is one field of type, after Lance Wyman's Mexico 68 logotype. The lines are level sets of the word's signed distance field, so the echoes of neighbouring letters meet in clean creases. The pointer is a second source: a dot that radiates rings of its own, smoothly merged into the word's wherever the two fields meet. A press sends a pulse out through every ring, each one carried a single line outward as it passes.
intent: Wyman's radiating parallel lines (https://www.vam.ac.uk/articles/iconic-design-official-poster-for-the-mexico-1968-olympic-games) as a union of distance fields: the word is one source, the hand is another, and the lines are what lies at equal distance from both.
